recentItems.title: Channing Tatum Addresses Alleged Burner Account & Zoë Kravitz Comments | E! News
recentItems.description:
Channing Tatum is setting the record straight. Amid speculation that he’s the secret owner of an Instagram responsible for leaving shady comments on his ex Zoë Kravitz's account, the 'Step Up' star addressed the rumors, denying being the unnamed user. "Yo i truly can't believe yall think this is what l'm doing with my free time," Tatum wrote in a statement shared to his Instagram Stories Sept. 21. "F--kin hilarious." And the 46-year-old also pointed out a notable flaw in the online theories, many of which claimed the mysterious Instagram was only followed by Tatum's verified account. "Also why would I follow a burner account if I didn't want people to connect me to it?" he continued. "Wtf, come on." In fact, Tatum—who shares daughter Everly, 12, with ex-wife Jenna Dewan—closed out his message by assuring fans there's only one place they should go if they want to hear directly from him. "If I really need to say it," the 'Magic Mike' actor added, "l only have one IG account, @channingtatum." Days before Tatum cleared the air, internet sleuths noticed an account named "Nonya Bidness" was commenting below several Instagram posts about Harry Styles and his fiancée Kravitz, who Tatum was engaged to before calling it quits in 2024. Under one post about a PDA moment between the "Watermelon Sugar" singer and 'High Fidelity' actress shared, the account wrote in a since-deleted comment, "Just here for the hate." recentItems.title: Dolly Parton's Estate Fires Nephew Bryan Seaver From Security Role | E! News
recentItems.description:
Dolly Parton's estate is cutting business ties with her nephew. Bryan Seaver, Dolly Parton’s nephew, and his security companies have been relieved of their duty to guard the “Jolene” singer’s properties, including her Nashville homes, museum and warehouse, according to the termination notice obtained by TMZ Sept. 21. Seaver called out Parton’s manager, Danny Nozell, as well as Pinnacle Bank—both of whom control the trust that manages the Grammy winner’s properties and business affairs—telling TMZ that he is “dismayed by the unexpected and, so far, unexplained actions” taken to remove him and accusing the two of acting in bad faith. E! News has reached out to Seaver, Nozell and reps for Parton and Pinnacle Bank for comment but has not yet heard back. recentItems.title: Former Fox News Staffer Jennifer Eckhart Dead at 36 | E! News
recentItems.description:
Content warning: This story discusses suicide. A former Fox News staffer was found dead in her Florida home. Journalist Jennifer Eckhart’s body was discovered inside the residence on Sept. 19, according to a Martin County Sheriff’s Office incident report obtained by People. She was 36. Sheriff spokesperson Christine Christofek told the outlet in a Sept. 21 statement, “This death has been ruled a suicide.” Eckhart had been detained six times in the past 18 months under Florida’s Baker Act, which allows individuals experiencing a severe mental health crisis to be held for 72 hours, Sheriff John Budensiek shared in a Sept. 21 press conference. “She spent a seven-week period in a mental health facility trying to get help for all her suicidal ideology,” he said, "and had been out of that facility for one week.” Budensiek said their investigation discovered that Eckhart had stopped taking her medication and had written in her personal ledger, “I need to kill myself. It’s the last thing to do.” E! News has reached out to the Martin County Sheriff’s Office for comment but has not yet heard back. If you or someone you know needs help, dial 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline or visit 988lifeline.org. recentItems.title: Untangling the Molly Sims and Bobbi Brown Drama Over Jones Road Beauty | E! News
recentItems.description:
Molly Sims isn't trying to conceal her disappointment. After Jones Road Beauty announced a new makeup line called "Wide Awake," the model called out the brand and its founder Bobbi Brown for using the same name as she did for her YISE brand’s best-selling under eye cream. “I don’t normally post stuff like this,” Sims, who founded YISE in 2023, said in a video shared to Instagram Sept. 19, “but over the last few days, I’ve had friends, customers, brand partners, retail partners DM, text, and email me that a brand that I love use and support not only use the exact name of a product I launched two years ago, but also their marketing copy and campaign feels a little too close to home.” Addressing Jones Road Beauty founder Bobbi Brown specifically, she added, "I can’t explain how disappointed—honestly, sad and hurt—I am to see this from another female founder who I’ve known for years and have looked up to in this industry." Brown responded by saying the company would be changing the name. Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1436304/molly-sims-bobbi-brown-drama-over-jones-road-beauty-explained

recentItems.title: Love Island USA's Clarke Carraway Reveals Reason for Taylor Williams Breakup | E! News
recentItems.description:
After Love Island USA season seven’s Taylor Williams and Clarke Carraway confirmed their breakup in July, she shared insight into what caused the split. "One of the things that I was asking him to fix: Taylor is super nice, super friendly," she explained to fellow Islander Kaylor Martin during the Sept. 20 episode of the Kaylor's Crash Outs podcast. “In a relationship, I run a strict program. I don't play that."  So when rumors first began that Williams had been unfaithful, with her even receiving a DM about him out with a female acquaintance, she ignored the speculation. However, that changed when a video began circulating of Williams, 26, speaking to another woman in close proximity. "I ignored the DMs. I asked him about it. 'It's cool, whatever,'" she recounted. "But to see the video come out, I'm here seeing it for the first time with everyone else." Indeed, Carraway said her partner's friendliness with the opposite sex made her uncomfortable, and it is what ultimately led to their separation. "If there's any questioning in any sort of relationship, whether that's platonic or romantic,” she emphasized. "I don't think that God would send someone my way, whether it's a friend or someone I'm talking to, that I would question." Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1434529/love-island-usas-clarke-carraway-reveals-taylor-williams-breakup-reason

recentItems.title: Taylor Swift to Receive First Ever Artist Director Honors at VMAs | E! News
recentItems.description:
Taylor Swift, who has directed over 15 of her own music videos, will receive the inaugural Artist Director Honors at the MTV VMAs Sept. 27, according to a press release obtained by E! News. The award recognizes musicians whose work behind the camera expands the possibilities of music video and visual storytelling—an apt next chapter for Swift, who first co-directed “Mine” in 2010 before taking the reins solo for “The Man.” The honor will give Swift her 31st VMA, breaking her 30-win tie with Beyoncé, while she also competes for nine more awards, including Video of the Year for “The Fate of Ophelia.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1436292/taylor-swift-to-receive-inaugural-artist-director-honors-at-vmas
